name: Datcord
tagline: An open-source Discord client that uses Firefox
blurb: Datcord is an open-source Discord client that respects your privacy.
description: Datcord is an open-source Discord client that respects your privacy. Datcord is a specialized version of Firefox (the official client is Chromium-based). Datcord handles emoji rendering better than the normal Discord client. Note that Discord can still track you even if you use Datcord. I chose Firefox for Datcord because Chromium-based browsers have a monopoly and if Firefox were to die out, only Chromium would be left.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
